selection: Common Crazyflow validation with radius .09, followed by Isaac development seed42. Existing selected policy is a fixed comparator. Separate untouched Isaac seeds431-435 for final acceptance. No target-evaluator dynamics or noise changes.

conditional_budget_extension.status: Preregistered before any A/B/C Isaac development or holdout evaluation.
conditional_budget_extension.trigger: After all A/B/C final policies complete common Crazyflow validation and identical Isaac development seed42, none has strictly higher Isaac success count than the fixed old policy while limiting common Crazyflow success-rate drop to2 percentage points.
conditional_budget_extension.case_choice: Among new A/B/C final policies, choose greatest Isaac development success count; ties choose greater common Crazyflow success count, then lexicographically smallest case name.
conditional_budget_extension.resume: Resume that case final checkpoint.msgpack exactly, including actor, real trained critic, Adam, normalizers, policy/environment RNG and complete environment/curriculum state. Do not initialize from PT/NPZ or recreate fresh environments.
conditional_budget_extension.fixed_settings: Same case config, num_envs, minibatches, horizon, epochs, variant, seed, training radius, physics/rewards/noise/randomization and all remaining invariant settings. Only target total iterations and output/logging paths may change.
conditional_budget_extension.comparison: Report this as a separate unequal-budget continuation, retaining the original equal122.88M A/B/C comparison. Evaluate the extended final policy once using the same common Crazyflow and Isaac development protocol and original eligibility gate.
conditional_budget_extension.stop_and_holdout: No second extension or further parameter tuning. Lock the selected winner before untouched Isaac seeds431..435; never use these holdout results to extend training or reselect a checkpoint.
